priority_findings.finding: The second closing exercise asks about a frequency anywhere in the open Q.24 AT&T transition gap between the named <=1.5% operate region and >=3.5% non-operate region, but its solution says that such a tone necessarily fails the declared local decision bands and returns REJECT. That is false under this lesson's frozen local detuning threshold at lines 192-200: offsets in (1.5%, 2.0%] pass the local <=2% detuning gate, whereas offsets above 2% fail it. Q.24 itself supplies no mandatory label in the transition gap. The solution must either specify an offset greater than 2% and less than 3.5%, or state the split local outcome instead of a blanket REJECT.

formula_coordinate_count_checks.check: At fs=8000 Hz, 2*770/8000=0.1925 and 2*1336/8000=0.334, so the stated angular frequencies are 0.1925pi and 0.334pi radians/sample. The raw negative-sign DFT and real-record conjugate symmetry relation are correct, as is the same-record/same-scale coordinate identity f/fs congruent to k/N modulo one.

The Q.23 group frequencies and key-5 mapping are correct. Independent DFT evaluation of samples 400-604 of the committed clean key-5 WAV gives top full-spectrum bins k=171 and k=34; an independent length-205 lone 770 Hz cosine gives top positive bins k=20 and k=19. Both counterexamples match the lesson.

N=205 at 8 kHz spans 25.625 ms and has spacing 39.02439024390244 Hz. Recomputed rows are 770 -> k20, 780.487804878049 Hz, +10.487804878049 Hz, +1.362052581565%; 1336 -> k34, 1326.829268292683 Hz, -9.170731707317 Hz, -0.686432014021%. Both bin centers lie inside the named +/-1.5% interval, without becoming exact nominal coordinates.
C_205(770) and X_205[20] use different exponents because 770/8000 !=20/205. Appending 51 zeros yields the 256 grid without new data; N=1 makes every selected-frequency projection equal x[0].

For key 8, 852 Hz maps to k22, 858.536585365854 Hz, +6.536585365854 Hz, +0.767204855147%; the repeated 1336-Hz row is correct. Neither 852/31.25=27.264 nor 1336/31.25=42.752 is integral, so neither exact-nominal projection is an ordinary N=256 bin.

The N=256 comment values recompute to 770 -> k25, 781.25 Hz, +1.461038961%; 1336 -> k43, 1343.75 Hz, +0.580089820%. Eight N=205 direct sums use 8N=1640 product slots and 8(N-1)=1632 additions. Lyons's real-input ledger gives 8(N+2)=1656 multiplications and 8(2N+1)=3288 additions. Literal 256 loops give 2048/2040, and the radix-2 256-point ledger gives 1024 twiddle slots and 2048 complex additions. Units remain separated.

The AT&T duration regions and all sample conversions recompute: 20/23/25/31/40/45 ms -> 160/184/200/248/320/360 samples at 8 kHz. A 205-sample frame is 25.625 ms and cannot certify 320 received samples. A symmetric 101-tap FIR has (101-1)/2=50 samples=6.25 ms group delay, correctly kept off the received-onset latency ledger.

Q.23's +/-1.8% sender tolerance is kept separate from the named Q.24 AT&T receiver profile. Verified AT&T values are operate offset <=1.5%, non-operate offset >=3.5%, high-minus-low twist -8 through +4 dB, operation duration >=40 ms, non-operation duration <=23 ms, pause >=40 ms, and interruption <=10 ms. The local 0.028/0.035/3 dB/-10..+5 dB/2% thresholds exactly match the training-selected study values and are labeled local.

All four demo facts match demo-preflight and receiver-study cards: two-low-013 false-accepts B; detuned and low-twist cases reject at their named gates; hard-7-031 emits 7 at 50 ms latency; 22 ms rejects; 26 ms is unscored; the 38 ms pause trial false-accepts 2 and needs the separate declared pause check.

All study counts, percentages, target comparisons, split descriptions, error identities, latency statistics, exclusions, and scope statements match the frozen result and independent reproduction. The script and result SHA-256 values in the lesson match recomputed hashes.

For N=205 and d=1.5, |sin(pi*d)/(205 sin(pi*d/205))|=0.21222528077336, or -13.4640576635 dB. Relative to amplitude 0.01=-40 dB, the leakage is 26.5359423365 dB higher. The zero-padding conclusion is correct because the observed length and rectangular kernel remain fixed.
